§aYour gateway to mid-game and beyond.§f

The Soldering Station is where circuits and machine upgrades get made. Craft it at the Tier 2 Anvil from cast steel plates, copper coils, tungsten bolts, and vacuum tubes.

It starts with the Analog Circuit Board, the first circuit tier and the gate to everything mid-game. From there you unlock machine upgrades like Speed, Effectiveness, and Overclock, plus the higher circuit tiers.

The station draws 100 HE/t for basic recipes and more for upgrades. Feed it capacitors, PCBs, and lead wire.

§ePS:§f This machine is worth automating early. You'll be coming back to it constantly.
